summary: Keep the visibly non-neutral Tone recipe and its existing self-reference rule.
evidence: +0.55 EV changes linear gain to about 1.46 and +0.18 contrast changes the tonal slope; the Tone eye bypasses both. The OFF Exposure and Contrast probes are already explicitly skipped at line 851; both Denoise probes still run.
proposed_fix: Keep Exposure +0.55 EV and Contrast +0.18 on IMG_7723.CR3 and DSC00636.ARW; keep the skips unchanged.
check: Phase 3 Tone ON/OFF pixel signature and both Denoise probe pairs; only ON has timed Tone impacts.

summary: The Bands seed authors a real correction, but the own-control selector is HDR-only.
evidence: seed clones currentToneEqualizerNodes and writes +0.8 EV to the middle node. The graph interpolates this change over nearby tones. The default rank is HDR; index.html uses #sdr-tone-equalizer-band-value on SDR, while RANGE.bands never substitutes the lane.
proposed_fix: Keep the normalized default node positions and set only nodes[floor(length/2)].adjustment_ev=+0.80 on IMG_7723.CR3 and DSC00636.ARW. Select that authored node and use the matching HDR/SDR slider ID for own timing.
check: Compare ON/OFF signatures and run own.bands slider drag in each lane; verify the active band changed.

summary: The luma seed bends the curve, but the own probe guesses the handle location without using the plot insets.
evidence: An authored mid-node at [0.5,0.58] bends the normalized luma mapping. canvasDrag clicks at 42% of the full canvas height; curveEditorLayout uses top=14 and bottom=34, so the pointer can miss the handle or hit another part of the curve.
proposed_fix: Keep luma [[0,0],[0.25,0.19],[0.5,0.58],[0.75,0.83],[1,1]] on IMG_7723.CR3 and DSC00636.ARW; use the editor's logical plot transform on [0.5,0.58] for the drag start.
check: Check ON/OFF signatures and assert an actual change to the seeded mid-point on own.curves.curve.drag.

summary: The Highlight Compression seed raises peak levels but the harness does not check that the cap was exercised.
evidence: Exposure +3 EV multiplies input by eight and the eye leaves Exposure alone, so 600 nits requires more than 75 nits before the boost if the rest of the pipeline is neutral. A compositor hash can differ from shoulder changes alone and does not verify that the bypassed image exceeded target.
proposed_fix: Use IMG_7723.CR3 and DSC00636.ARW with Exposure +3 EV in both states, Peak Fit / maximum, HDR target 600 nits and Start 200 nits (on the native 25-nit grid). For explicit SDR runs use Peak Fit / maximum and Start 55%. Confirm HDR OFF pre-limiter peak >600 and ON finished peak <=600 before accepting the row.
check: Phase 3 Highlight Compression eye/impact signatures plus pre-limiter HDR peak and exact finished ceiling checks.

summary: Every native Tone input redraws both highlight graphs and runs unrelated global panel bookkeeping before scheduling a frame.
evidence: app-boot.js input listener calls commitAdjustmentValue synchronously. renderControlState walks all rows and groups, calls HSL and Film UI renderers, and renders both highlight plots with 161 curve samples apiece; only GPU rendering is coalesced.
felt_impact: Unmeasured estimate: roughly 5–20 ms of whole first feedback at Fit under dense events, or one missed frame; settle likely little changed.
proposed_fix: Keep slider value/readout synchronous; batch dependent graph and badge updates once per animation frame, flush final values on release, and leave preview invalidation semantics unchanged.
check: Audit own Tone Exposure/Contrast and all impact Tone probes; sample time in input handlers and compare first feedback and settle.

summary: Direct SDR Peak Fit brackets a GPU-to-CPU peak readback around each eligible frame, including live draws when liveMode is set.
evidence: finishedSdrAnchor requires direct SDR and Peak Fit with an automatic anchor; settled frames qualify even with a canonical cache entry. renderToFrame submits the graph, reduces the entire finish texture into a frame-serial cache entry, awaits mapAsync, deletes the entry, then resumes presentation. Interactive frames only take this route when frameAnchor or liveMode is active.
felt_impact: Unmeasured estimate for an eligible cache hit: roughly 10–40 ms Fit or 30–100 ms at larger Direct sizes out of the whole feedback/settle wait; no expected gain for normal HDR drag.
proposed_fix: First measure the eligible route. Reuse an identical finished-signal peak where graph inputs, route/mip and signal selection match; otherwise keep first feedback independent only if the existing interactive image contract is preserved.
check: Run --lane sdr Highlight Compression and Tone impact probes, log liveMode, frameAnchor, execution mode and mapAsync timing; compare first feedback/settle and validate SDR parity.

summary: A warm reduced Clean Grain delta can still be blended up front on every Tone frame.
evidence: The reduction key does not include Tone; when ensureFineGrainReduced returns cleanGrainDelta, renderToFrame allocates and submits another Fit blend before the grade, then retires it in finally, even when only Exposure or Contrast changed.
felt_impact: Unmeasured estimate: roughly 5–25 ms of whole Fit first feedback with a qualifying warm Clean Grain setup; otherwise zero.
proposed_fix: Retain one allocator-budgeted resolved blend keyed by the reduced texture identity plus colorSplotches strength; invalidate on source/mip/control change.
check: Compare tone.exposure and tone.contrast in a supplemental warm Clean Grain ON repeat; H1's isolated slide and Denoise toggle steps alone do not test this combined state. Count Fit blend dispatches and compare GPU-fenced first feedback.

summary: Moving an already-active global curve can reuse Detail's sharpen bands from the previous curve on the tiled route.
evidence: detailBandIdentity hashes serialized parameter slots and proxy identity. Curve point values live in a separate LUT buffer; moving a point with the same enabled-channel bits does not alter this key. renderTiles runs the new base shader, then reuses packed Detail bands from the old base when packed.hit and halo assembly succeed.
proposed_fix: Key packed global Detail bands by the effective global curve points/LUT identity as well as the upstream params; preserve reuse when the curve is unchanged.
check: At 100% force Tiled, enable global Sharpen/Texture, prime an active luma curve, move its existing point, and compare to the same grade after a cold tile-cache reset and CPU within tolerance.
